summary.text: Greg Alexander is a Republican state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 98 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Carsonville resident, he owns an apple orchard and previously served as Sanilac County drain commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Greg Alexander, listed by Ballotpedia as Gregory Alexander, lives in Carsonville, Michigan, and graduated from Carsonville-Port Sanilac High School.
His career experience includes owning an apple orchard.
Alexander has served as the drain commissioner of Sanilac County and as the utility and community development director of the City of Croswell.
In 2025 and 2026 Alexander is assigned to the House Agriculture, Elections and Ethics, Financial Services and Transportation committees, and he is the Transportation Committee's majority vice chair.
